metadataRaw.title: 5 Safest Sciatica Exercises (FOR LONG LASTING RELIEF)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 5 safe exercises to use for both quick and long-lasting sciatica pain relief.

All of the exercises are tried and true methods that don't involve any awkward or difficult movements. 

A note, each exercise works a little differently. They're going to target various causes of sciatica, including bulging (or herniated) discs causing pinched nerves and muscle-related sciatic nerve compression.

To get the best results, go through all the exercises and use what gives you the most relief.

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:37 Muscle Release
3:38 Nerve Flossing
5:39 Stretching Exercise 1
8:06 Stretching Exercise 2
